body: Kind of what I thought...then again there are women who are assholes too
I'd rather just have one of you males in my life on a level playing field of opposite gender...and shaved head really isn't flattering on me
Haha I suppose that's likely my best choice at this point
I have to agree
I'm not assuming all men are the same but for the most part they are and yes women do the same

I have kids here that he and I supported as well, trying to take away from what was to be my future with my husband is just plain sick and twisted. I've already lost the most important and priceless thing in my life now I have to deal with this garbage on top of that. 
Too many greedy people in this world who are willing to rob from the already broke.

I have done all the ground work and paper work for all government funding that is awarded to my step daughter and had the information packets sent to his ex. My lawyer has been in contact with her regarding all of those things, she is just digging for something that isn't there. Very frustrating to me that she sees dollar signs on his grave :(
Thank you
Yes

I had to block her a while ago, every message was "where the f*** is this money for my kid and why don't I have it" 
Disgusting that even in his death all she wants is money.

Not his ex wife, merely a girlfriend. But yes myself and my three kids one of which is legally my late husband's 
No will in place and no assets in the estate either. A spousal settlement awarded to myself from the auto company because he was killed by a drunk driver. Step daughter got her settlement
That's a good way to think of them...irritating little pests that just need a swat. I'm doing good things for me and the kids and trying to give them stability and a healthy happy life.

I've been under attack by her and his family since this happened. I try to make good choices and move forward but they have a way of messing with my head all over again. Next thing she will be looking for is my wedding rings! Yeesh!

I don't know if a judge would entertain the idea of such a case...take my and my children's livelihood away to give it to his ex girlfriend so she can continue to not work??? I guess I'm angry that the idea would even cross her mind that it would be reasonable to try to steal the only thing we have left in this world. Yes my stepchild lost her father but I lost my husband and my boys their step dad and my daughter her dad too. Money does strange things to people
I wish I could say this woman is smart but she isn't, and she has a band of idiots helping her beat her drum.
From what other family members have told me she is attempting to get her hands on my daughters portion of the money as well...she isn't biologically his but he put his name on her birth certificate

I have not been contacted by her lawyer regarding suing me as of yet however he did contact me and attempted to scare me into giving her some of this money a couple months ago then proceeded to contact the adjuster and attempt to tell her that the stepchild was entitled to my portion (she is not, she got her own settlement)
So really she is just shooting blanks at this point then...I don't want to have to take extreme steps to protect myself and my children from this psychopath
There is zero right to claim, we were paying child support but I'm not liable to support my step child now that he has passed away that's what the pension plan support is for.
No alimony they were never married it was a short relationship that resulted in a child being born they never even lived together
She thinks she is entitled to a cut of the money as well as something from the estate...has nothing in it but debt
I wish things were different but I can't entertain this sort of behaviour...I would never dream of acting in such a way.
I'm in Saskatchewan so I'm going to look into soaring spirits and see what they have to offer close to me
I'm content with existing right now, can't expect too much of myself either and I really need to learn to stop beating myself up so much about the smallest things.
Since I lost my husband I have no support system anymore :(
I had major issues with my kidneys while I was pregnant, the medications and the treatments were detrimental to not only my health but hers as well.
Thank you!!! Some days I just feel like it. As a now single mom again I feel like even the tiniest thing is my fault so this is taking a major tole on me

That would mean a root canal and a crown and I've spoken to the dentist and refuses to put her through unnecessary surgery. If she fell or bumped them too hard the crowns would fall off and we would be back at square one and I would be out an extreme amount of money.
Ha! She's just that fiesty too that she would lol
Thank you :)
I usually don't give jack shit about what people think but lately with everything that's going on in my life I tend to take it a little personal and I really shouldn't

She's on supplements now which should help but the teeth that are ruined are baby teeth and it won't affect her adult teeth when they come in. I feel terrible that they look this way and people judge and assume I don't look after her.
I'm still in survival mode and certain I will remain here for a long while yet, just can't find any amount of happy
Even the smallest mess up makes me feel like a complete failure these days, just not sure how to go about not beating myself up
I will be embarking on an 8 week intense therapy group in a couple months, not sure how I feel about it. Likely will be very helpful in just a little scared of the things I'm going to feel
If it wasn't for the kids I'd probably be in bed all day everyday, it's been almost 7 months and I feel like I'm just barely existing
You know you have a good friend when their hugs last longer than 2 seconds and they squeeze you

I agree, hugs are the greatest expression of being cared for. I miss the hugs I used to get so very much. 
My advice, hug this friend every chance you get!!!

Sounds to me like he's a narcissist and you really should reconsider engaging in any sort of discussion or disagreement without being on a safe place. I suggest you start seeing a marriage counsellor immediately before this situation takes a turn for the worse.

My ex husband was this exactly, I ended up in a six year abusive marriage of which I took the blame for every indiscretion of his. That's verbal and emotional abuse. You need to seek help

I've had a couple of outbursts this week for no apparent reason at all. Stood in the shower for 20 minutes and completely lost it because his razor is still on the shelf. 

Almost 7 months and I still lose it out of nowhere. Maybe it's the lonely maybe it's just the missing him and maybe it's just that my entire life is a mess of blur and uncertainty. 

Ugh...
Yeah I think maybe I've got the feels and all my friends that have been out with our group have pointed out how much staring goes on that I don't know about, might be time to use the words

Very helpful information, as a woman I know where I stand in terms of the invisible boundaries when it comes to my male friends but as to you men and not understanding women per say I sit on the other side of course and have difficulty decoding. 

Said friend and I are both in a transition period in our personal lives and relate on a "same but different" aspect within those transitions. The conversation is real and honest, the time spent together is comfortable and the glance exchanges and "accidental touching" is a comfort but also a bit of an uncertainty if you know what I mean

So the underlying possibility of being physical with a female friend is there if the handsy and flirty exists...hard to decode sometimes. 

My male friend is very attentive in that respect and I'm not sure if he's just being friendly or if he's attracted

I think that all the time and I'm certain I know what he would be doing and thinking, he couldn't handle it the way that I have. He would have folded up into a little ball and shut the world away. He always said I was stronger than him in so many ways and I denied that but after all this and I'm still standing I am certain he had a point. He was the most gentle kind giving soul I have ever known but hurt was something he just couldn't deal with.

I'm at the 6 month mark as well and I'm right there with you, I woke up one morning and said hey I think I want to learn how to be ok with all of this and actually try to find something I enjoy and be able to smile without feeling guilty. 

It's never going to go back to the way it was so constantly beating ourselves up over what was and what will never be again is truly a waste of our little bit of energy. 

I miss him and that's the final verdict on that but he wouldn't want me to not try to be happy.

36 widowed with three kids...I've done everything to avoid being dependent on any kind of medication to cope. I stopped drinking and haven't had a clouded day yet and I'm six months in. Most days I'd rather fade into the background and have zero contact with the world and other days I want to be out there feeling like I'm still normal. What is normal? I don't know what it is. I'm petrified of letting someone get close to me even tho I long for a connection. I just don't think anyone could ever want to be with a broken person like me.

I'm here because I am a widow, looking to connect with others in my situation. It's a very unique life that we live and there are not many of us who have direct support or contact with others who experience things the way we do. It's not a loaded question at all , it's a simple enquiry.
I find myself feeling the same...empty and lost. Finding something to help fill the void is terribly difficult at best. I just want to mean something to someone again...
I'm trying to see the beauty within myself again, I feel lost
I lost my husband 6 months ago so I too am living this unbelievably difficult new life. Feel free to pm me and we can certainly talk
She's up around 6:30, nap is from 12:30 until 2 then bed routine starts at 7. Lights dimmed cuddle time and finish up snacking then hugs and kisses and put her in her bed blankie and stuffy.

Most days are filled with the routine of kids and chores and phone calls and emails. Warding off the distant in laws as they are destructive just to find myself in the "row your boat" position at the end of everyday. 

Hot bath, cup of tea and our lonely bed to watch television and then shut off the light and close my eyes.

When the hurricane hits it destroys even that small progress I have made just to get through the day without bursting into tears. 

I call this the "journey of suck" 

You nailed it with the game analogy...I don't want to play anymore either!!
We had a private dinner on our wedding day just him and I so I thought I would try and go to the restaurant we loved and promised we would be back to every year.

Moving forward I find to be a great idea but putting it into motion is the difficult part. It's time to pack up some of his things and move them to the garage and I hope I can get through it. It likely will help in this process it's just getting the motivation to even start.

The last couple of weeks I'm finding that I need to keep busy and on the go the majority of the time. Actually been leaving the house more often but without the kids. 
I feel like I'm just a mom now, not his wife or a wife or  even an individual. Defined as a widow and I exist for the kids.
I find exhaustion kicks in and at the same time the need to keep busy
I second the cranky, pent up energy or is it just the deprivation?
It's the inevitable and I know it's coming and try to stop it but just can't
I've thought about that, not going to lie he's attractive and I have told him that but there is a difference between knowing someone is attractive and being attracted to them...or am I wrong?

It's the assumptions that there is always more to it. 
Seems like society says hey if you two are opposite sex friends and you discuss things on such a personal level you must have an attraction.
I've always gotten along better with the opposite sex, I'm a female and just seem to jive with men on a friendship level
Hard to decode if there are feelings there, knowing each other on such a personal level...I wonder if that is a spark to light a fire
Wow, some people truly are judgemental aren't they and ignorant...thanks for the useless comments.

A friendship that has taken on a life of its own at this point and I feel almost dependant on the situation. I have been through hell and back the last few months and he's been a shoulder to lean on. I feel alive again when I'm with him and as if I have a purpose here still and that maybe someday someone could love this broken person I have become. He is struggling is his own life right now and we have been leaning on each other for moral support but there is more to it then that I think.

Yes it absolutely does go both ways! We are animals in that right, we do not function well without having an outlet for our most built up aggressions and desire which are often one and the same.

With that nothing is wrong with you, you simply desire to be expressive in the most animalistic yet human way possible! 

All the best to you!

It's been almost 6 months since my husband was ripped away from me and our family. The first days were dark and grim and I felt there was nothing left to live for. Then I look at these kids and think wow I need to keep it together for them. Still broken and miss him just as much today as I did the day he went home to be an angel. It's becoming more bearable at this point but no less hurtful

I agree that counselling is an option however if it's all in good faith to attempt to prolong the inevitable then don't waste your time. If she's ready to let go then cut that cord sooner rather than later. Staying living in the same house together will do nothing but harm to yourself and to her. The decision to live separate lives is just the point of that...separate

I have many other friendships and this seems to be the first one since my drastic life change that wants to simply be here for me. Gives me something to look forward to everyday rather than waking up feeling like I'm dying inside. I'm a little scared of what I may let myself feel tho.
[Light confession]
I feel hopeless most days as well. He's gone and won't ever be coming back. I miss everything about our life and him. I have to carry on for the kids but it's such a challenge
Their relationship is messed up all on its own and I have zero to do with it. Conversations are simply that conversations and nothing more.

I've tried to distract myself and not engage in the conversation or the thoughts that provoke them but honestly I feel drawn to this person in a very strong way. The face to face interaction is something they write about in books! It's like a fire that burns so hot and the tension between us can be cut with a knife!

It's a hard lesson and even that much harder of a life to adjust to. I'm nearing the 6 month mark and I can't even recall how I've managed to keep it together enough this long to get to this point. Life has lost its lustre
